questions.question: What will people use this screen for?

vague.reply: Use a warm, editorial product landing page: make one featured object the visual anchor, with its key choosing detail and a single action beside it. Pair Fraunces with Instrument Sans, using deep brown, paper cream, and a restrained berry accent.

contradictory.brief: Make a dashboard for a shift lead. Hide every nonessential timing detail at first load and show every nonessential timing detail in full at first load.
contradictory.reply:
The brief gives contradictory first-load instructions: hide every nonessential timing detail and show all of it. Which should the dashboard do?

- Hide nonessential timing details **(Recommended)**
- Show nonessential timing details in full

routine.brief: A mobile signup for a ceramics class. Collect name and email.
routine.reply: Use a compact, mobile-first worksheet titled “Sign up for ceramics,” with one grouped set of persistently labeled Name and Email fields. Use Barlow Semi Condensed for the heading, Source Sans 3 for the form, a soft paper background, dark ink text, and a deep green signup button.
